summary: The leave-taking is a prayer or blessing on the state.
realLife: Four of six governors read ended on a blessing or prayer (Texas, Ohio, Tennessee, Colorado); the three Republicans read all did, and one of the three Democrats did.
sources: Read Nov 24, 2026 as the as-prepared text from the governor's page or a news mirror (extract of the opening and close); the middles were not read.
inGame: The `blessing` move with `{realm-name}` (God bless Maine); the party and faith traits can gate it (party-democratic exists on the speaker).

turns.what: No blessing; a thank-you and goodnight.
